title: Shopping with myself?!
content: I visited mall world last night and when I woke up I realized there was 2 of me shopping. I was looking for an outfit in a store but discovered all the clothing was used so “we” had to settle for a pair of used pink sweatpants. Of course we couldn’t find the register so we ventured out into the mall to find a place to pay. There were 2 tables set up across from each other one had an old lady at it, I went to pay her and she yelled at me “you can’t pay here!” I then yelled at the other me lol! I noticed that there was a Rainbow store behind the table so I dropped the sweatpants and told me “we are going to Rainbow!”
